title: Leaf spaces and transverse structures — Question 8.8
exact_target: Recognize when a group acting minimally on a pair of transverse circle laminations is commensurable with a hyperbolic three-manifold group.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300031 (AMR-102-0031). CC BY 4.0.
